scope: Conditional engine candidates; nominal sizing heuristic, not measured lift. No performance scores assigned.

integrations.verified: Product 2027, sizes 600/700/825/950/1100 and 3BS+ connection stated by manufacturer. Only 825 supported in conditional engine from reviewed test.
integrations.rule: Intermediate and above, allround or glide; excluded for ease priority. Surface selected by existing nominal heuristic, no calibrated lift coefficient. No guaranteed weight or wind range.
integrations.limits: Manufacturer recommendations do not establish exact compatibility of every test tail. Check full assembly. 80–90 kg describes testers, not eligibility threshold.

integrations.verified: Manufacturer confirms 550/670/800/950, surf/freestyle orientation and low-end versus speed tradeoff. Only tested 670/800 enter conditional engine.
integrations.rule: Advanced and expert, surf or jump; excluded for ease priority and lightwind programme. Existing nominal sizing heuristic only. Short fuselage handling warning retained.
integrations.limits: Shared observations do not establish separate measured performance by size; setup and shim compatibility require reference check. No extrapolated 80/90 kg selection threshold.
